{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_df = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline (before filtering for SEVERE):")
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients
print("Sentinel values in biomarker_baseline for SEVERE patients:")
print(severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].unique())"}
